text: {"status":"ANSWERED","claims":[{"text":"Before sharing PHI with a third party, approval from both the data owner and the Chief Privacy Officer is required.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Sharing Restricted information requires approval from both the data owner and the Chief Privacy Officer."},{"text":"Before sharing PHI with a third party, a signed Business Associate Agreement is required.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Sharing protected health information (PHI) additionally requires a signed Business Associate Agreement"},{"text":"Before a third party receives PHI, it must pass a Vendor Security Assessment if the PHI is Restricted information.","evidence_id":"E4","quote":"A third party must pass a Vendor Security Assessment before it receives any Confidential or Restricted information."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":[],"conflict_note":""}
